_description: Extracted energy flow data from Prius Gen 2 CAN/AVC-LAN recording

_can_ids_decoded.0x3CB: SOC, current limits, battery temps (100ms, unsolicited)
_can_ids_decoded.0x3CD: Fault code & pack voltage raw (100ms, unsolicited)
_can_ids_decoded.0x3C8: System status / ICE RPM target (70ms, unsolicited)
_can_ids_decoded.21C3: Hybrid system: MG1/MG2 RPM, torque, temps, HV V/I (solicited from 0x7E2)
_can_ids_decoded.21CE: Battery SOC, current, 14 block voltages (solicited from 0x7E3)
_can_ids_decoded.21CF: Battery limits, delta SOC, aux voltage, fan (solicited from 0x7E3)
